source.title: Newry Reporter, 8 June 1961, p. 6 ("Newry No. 1 Rural District: notice of result of elections")
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the notice of result read in the Newry Reporter of 8 June 1961.

note: Triennial election of Newry No. 1 Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Fourteen divisions; only Damolly was contested. The returning officer's notice of result gives the votes and the returned member for every division. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
